result.rationale: The diff adds `totalPages: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` in admin-group.js.es6. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100/50), this yields 3 pages instead of 2 (Math.ceil gives 2), and `showingLast` (currentPage == totalPages) will be false on the real last page, keeping 'next' enabled to navigate to an empty page. The mechanism is verifiable directly from the shown code.

adjudication.rationale: `totalPages` in `admin-group.js.es6` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (with only a `user_count == 0` guard). When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit`, this overcounts by 1 (e.g. 100/50 => 3). This directly affects `showingLast` (`propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")`) and the `next` action, so the UI will keep “next” enabled on the real last page and can advance to `offset == user_count`, which `findMembers` will request and the backend will return an empty `members` list for.
